description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of several large language models across different evaluation datasets. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation datasets, labeled “EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score”, displays values ranging from 0 to 1, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.10. Each dataset has a set of three bars representing the scores of three different models: “RedWhale (our)” in dark blue, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” in medium blue, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” in light gray. For the “EVAL” dataset, the “RedWhale (our)” score is approximately 0.42, the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” score is 0.46, and the “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” score is 0.56. The “AVG” dataset shows scores of 0.59 for “RedWhale (our)”, 0.61 for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0”, and 0.73 for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)”. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each model’s score represented side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized, and the datasets are not sorted by any apparent criteria.
